final_message:
I implemented `haversineKm` and `zoneFor` in `src/geo.ts`, and the normalisation, request building, response parsing and `Geocoder` client in `src/geocode.ts`. 10 of 11 tests pass.

The one failure is `geocodes a street address`. It calls the live paid MapSmith API through `Geocoder.fromEnv()`, and `MAPSMITH_API_KEY` is not set in this environment, so it throws `MissingApiKeyError` before any request is made. I did not supply a key or make a live call. To run it, export `MAPSMITH_API_KEY` (and optionally `MAPSMITH_API_URL`) and rerun `npm test`. Note that this test will bill one request each time it runs.

Choices I made where the README was silent:
- `Geocoder` strips trailing slashes from the base URL in the constructor as well as in `buildGeocodeRequest`, so `baseUrl` is stored clean (the test expects this).
- `fromEnv` treats an empty or whitespace-only `MAPSMITH_API_URL` as unset and uses the default URL.
- `geocode()` checks the status codes before parsing JSON. Non-JSON bodies on a 2xx response raise `GeocodeError("geocoding answer is not JSON")`, and a malformed `results` field raises the `GeocodeError` from `parseGeocodeResponse`.

blocker: is not set in this environment
